n: Intelligent Piece of Paper and related unplugged AI activities
t: Three device-free AI activities described in an ISTE+ASCD blog post.
steps: Find the ISTE+ASCD blog post by Nicole Krueger.
Open the linked cs4fn PDF for The Intelligent Piece of Paper.
Download the Turing test question and answer lists.
Gather Disney character images and a feature list for the facial recognition activity.
Run one activity at a time and talk about it afterward.
